message.content: Keysight Technologies Inc serves technology innovators as a mission-critical design enablement partner for complex engineering challenges across end markets including AI infrastructure, communications, industrial automation, aerospace and defense, automotive, semiconductor, and general electronics [D1]. The company sells its solutions to customers who rely on Keysight to bridge virtual design and physical reality, enabling confident decisions earlier in the development lifecycle [D1]. Its portfolio enables customers to solve complex engineering challenges across these end markets by connecting market-leading design, emulation, and test solutions across the full lifecycle [D1].
